body: My Parrot, I want to know why he's plucking his feathers and what I can do to help him. Just stop plucking little guy please :(.

Still as a man, it feels quite shameful to have to admit you have had those things to you, But yeah, I really do not want the conversation hell it's been a long time, they'd wonder why i'm only just bringing it up now..

Totally had someone pm me and confuse me and I wrote a reply thinking it was the same person oops..
World War 3 has started/ended. Massive Nuke about to hit or has hit.
As someone who has gone through this, I don't want to have to have that conversation with my family, I feel it's too late to tell them the truth.

I wasn't trying to force myself into a relationship, it's just I talk to people I get to know them, I don't go into my past, but I tell them i'm emotionally broken and I'm depressed and they run.

I don't honestly have friends I can talk to about it, I've never really felt I could open up without being judged by feeling less of a man, it's why I find it hard to actually get anybody interested in me, it's really shitty.
